versions.changelog:
- This version changes the skill from a file/binary converter tool to an index and routing skill for locating and installing the current canonical AgentPMT skills via the AgentPMT ClawHub org account.
- Provides up-to-date links and install commands for all current AgentPMT setup and product skills published by the AgentPMT org.
- Adds a detailed table guiding when and how to use each current AgentPMT skill.
- Includes direct full-page URLs for reliable routing; instructs to use only these for handoff or installs.
- No credential or wallet setup required—serves as an informational and routing resource only.

Initial release of AgentPMT Tool: Binary To/From File Converter skill.

- Enables seamless conversion between base64, hex, and binary data formats, and transfers between these formats and files (up to 10MB).
- Supports cloud storage operations: extract base64 from stored files or create files from uploaded base64 data with customizable expiry and metadata.
- Integrates authentication and credit management with AgentPMT, allowing wallet-based signature flows, credit purchases, and job-based credit earning.
- Public API endpoints provided for all operations, with detailed action mappings and payload structures outlined for developers.
- Comprehensive session, signature, and funding instructions included for smooth integration into automated workflows.
